name: skills
description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
one_liner: A free set of instruction files that make an AI coding assistant ask better questions and follow a disciplined process, instead of just guessing at what you want.
buyer: A tech lead at a small agency who wants every client project's AI-assisted work to follow the same requirements-gathering and documentation process, without writing that playbook from scratch.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer installs the 'grill-me' skill so every new client engagement starts with a structured requirements interview, cutting back-and-forth revisions.
An agency owner standardizes onboarding so every contractor's AI agent behaves the same way, making outsourced work more consistent and easier to review.
A solo SaaS founder uses the shared-language skill to stop re-explaining project jargon to the agent every session, saving prompting time.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid workshop teaching teams how to adapt this exact skill workflow to their own codebase and onboarding process.
Maintain a premium fork with industry-specific skill packs (agency, fintech, healthcare) behind a subscription.

steal_this: Package the 'grill-me' requirements-gathering skill as a $19 Gumroad template aimed at freelancers who want to look more professional on client calls.
